soldier: Body small; head dull yellow, the labrum and postmentum slightly darker and pale brown, the mandibles reddish brown and paler in the basal third, the thorax, abdomen and appendages pale yellow. Setae on the head few, almost without fine hairs; the clypeus with only one pair of setae; the apical setae and the subapical setae of the labrum markedly long, the subapical setae well developed. Head nearly rectangular, the sides rather parallel, the posterior corners broadly rounded, the posterior margin arcuate, widest near the middle. Labrum elongate-lingulate, the apex broadly rounded, the lateral margins nearly parallel. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apices slightly incurved; the tooth of the left mandible at one-third from the apex, its apex forwards, with a minute tooth in the basal notch; the right mandibular tooth very small, with another small tooth near the base. Postmentum elongate, about twice as long as wide, the sides of the posterior part almost parallel or slightly arched. Antennae with 15 segments, segment 3 the smallest, segment 5 slightly larger than segment 3. The anterior margin of the pronotum is deeply incised at the two muscle scars, the width between the two scars being less than the length of the median axis, and both the anterior and the posterior margin are distinctly concave at the middle.
